description.zh:
节点类型，查询 PolarDB Search节点账号时需要传入

- Search
description.en:
The node type. Required when you query the PolarDB search node account

- Search

description.zh: 页码，取值范围为大于0但不超过Integer最大值的整数。默认值为**1**。
description.en: The page number of the returned page. The value must be an integer that is larger than 0. The default value is **1**.

The number of entries returned per page. Valid values:

- **30**

- **50**

- **100**

The default value is **30**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb describe-accounts --db-cluster-id pc-000000000000000 --account-name test_acc --node-type Search --page-number 1 --page-size 30 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb DescribeAccounts --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 30 --PageNumber 1 --NodeType Search --DBClusterId 'pc-000000000000000' --AccountName test_acc
